scope: length and mnemonic of 64-bit-mode instructions; mnemonics follow Intel names in Capstone's spelling (je not jz, cmove not cmovz, movabs for B8+r with REX.W, 'lock '/'rep ' fused into the mnemonic)

prefixes.evex: 62 (always EVEX in 64-bit mode): P0 R X B R' 0 m m m; P1 W vvvv 1 pp; P2 z L'L b V' aaa (SDM Vol 2A 2.7)
prefixes.xop: 8F with (next byte & 0x1F) >= 8: like 3-byte VEX, maps 8/9/A (AMD APM Vol 6); otherwise 8F is POP r/m

immediates.moffs: absolute address: 8 bytes, or 4 with 67 address-size (SDM Vol 2A 2.2.1.4)
